warnings.label: The tidal Deben estuary
warnings.message:
High tides overnight may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 1:30am to 3:30am on Wednesday 14th October. 
Tide levels will be high around the boat yard in Felixstowe Ferry hamlet at the end of Ferry Road, and along riverside areas in Woodbridge and Waldringfield, as well as in surrounding marshland. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at  Harwich of 2.7mAODN at 2:30am on Wednesday 14th October, which is 0.71m above tide tables, Wind Force 4, Westerly. No further high tides are expected over the coming days. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded.   
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Wednesday 14 October or as the situation changes.

Flooding is possible from 1:30am to 3:30am on Wednesday 14th October. 
Clacton Promenade, Lee-over-Sands, and the front at Brightlingsea may experience some wave overtopping and spray. The Strood at Mersea Island, Coast Road and car parks on the front at West Mersea, and the Hythe and Promenade at Maldon, may be flooded. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at  Clacton of 2.94mAODN at 2:30am on Wednesday 14th October, which is 0.5m above tide tables, Wind Force 4, Westerly. Tides will remain high over the next couple of days. 
We are closely monitoring the situation .

This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Wednesday 14 October or as the situation changes.
